The '''Sand Splitter Cave''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], west of the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]] and south of the [[Valley of the Winds]].

==History==
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the cave was used as a base of operations for a criminal organization known as the Sand Splitters. Among the cave's residents included a number of Sand Splitter knaves and brutes, and two of the organization's leaders, a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] named [[Erib Kurrugh]] and a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Saul Rouse]].<ref name="SWG:JPRY" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> when the Sand Splitters stole [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] ledger and prototype [[The Candle|warhead]], [[Ree-Yees/Legends|Ree-Yees]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with recovering the stolen items, and [[Death/Legends|killing]] the two founders, with the hope that the criminal organization would collapse without the guidance of their leaders.<ref name="SWG:JPRY" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sand Splitter Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JPRY" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Sand Splitter Cave was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Jabba's Theme Park|Jabba's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:JPRY" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
